live-provider-anthropic-oauth.description: anthropic provider live run needs Claude Max OAuth in the macOS keychain (useClaudeOauth:true, no API key). Required only when AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1 enables the anthropic matrix case; absent => that provider case skips (not fails). VERIFIED live 2026-06-26 via useClaudeOauth (Claude Max keychain): a {type:anthropic, useClaudeOauth:true} agent ran end-to-end with real telemetry — the orchestrator must NOT re-halt on this blocker.
live-provider-anthropic-oauth.how_to_provide: Sign in to Claude Code so the OAuth token is in the login keychain (Claude Max); or export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Then set AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1.

live-provider-claudecli.description: claudecli provider live run needs the 'claude' CLI installed and authenticated (drives stream-json; config {claudePath,model}). Required for the claudecli matrix case under AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1 AND as the default REAL provider for dod.5's composition-journey run step; absent => the affected case skips (not fails). (verified live 2026-06-26 — claudecli drives the local Claude CLI end-to-end.)
live-provider-claudecli.how_to_provide: Install the Claude Code CLI (npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code or equivalent) and ensure 'claude' is on PATH and logged in. Set CLAUDE_CLI_PATH if non-standard.

live-provider-lmstudio.description: lmstudio provider live run needs a running LM Studio OpenAI-compatible server reachable at LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL (config {model,baseURL}). Required only for the lmstudio matrix case under AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1; absent => that case skips (not fails). (verified live 2026-06-26 — lmstudio configured via .mcp.json env (LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL/API key in ~/.adhd/agent-mcp/.env).)
live-provider-lmstudio.how_to_provide: Start LM Studio's local server with a model loaded; export LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL (e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1). Set AGENT_MCP_LIVE=1.

sox-package-publish.description: The MINIMAL 3-package set — @adhd/sox-embedding-provider, @adhd/sox-vector-store, @adhd/sox-ingest — must be resolvable as npm deps before embedding-substrate/enrichment-pipeline add them to packages/agent/agent-store-prompts/package.json. All three 404 on npm as of 2026-07-08 (only @adhd/sox-memory-core@0.2.1 is published). These are ESM packages ("type":"module", exports.import) so the probe uses dynamic import(), NOT require(). enrichment-pipeline consumes the @adhd/sox-ingest/core SUBPATH specifically (dep-free: node:crypto only — avoids web-tree-sitter/tree-sitter-wasms pulled by the root barrel's AstChunker), so the probe imports both '@adhd/sox-ingest' AND '@adhd/sox-ingest/core'. CAVEAT: the ./core export + src/core.ts are currently UNCOMMITTED in sox-ecosystem's working tree (untracked) — this blocker must confirm @adhd/sox-ingest/core actually resolves before enrichment-pipeline starts. @adhd/sox-analysis and @adhd/sox-memory-core are NOT required by this plan (D-summary calls ingest() directly) and are intentionally omitted. Supply via changesets publish from sox-ecosystem (pnpm rewrites workspace:* at pack time — decisions.md §D5). NOTE: the sox-ingest-publishable blocker is now VERIFIED (commit f4897aa: private:false + invariant removed).
sox-package-publish.how_to_provide: In sox-ecosystem: make @adhd/sox-ingest publishable (see sox-ingest-publishable), then `pnpm changeset` + `pnpm changeset version` + `pnpm publish -r` for the 3 packages. Then add them as ^0.1.0 deps to agent-store-prompts and confirm the dynamic-import probe prints ALL 3 RESOLVE OK.

sox-ingest-publishable.description: RESOLVED 2026-07-08 by sox-ecosystem commit f4897aa (P1(ingest-public): expose @adhd/sox-ingest public surface). @adhd/sox-ingest previously carried package.json private:true + a source header invariant 'PRIVATE — never published to npm; only the memory domain composer may call this package'. That commit sets private:false and DELETES the header invariant, so @adhd/agent-store-prompts (NOT the memory domain composer) importing ingest() directly is now sanctioned. Kept as a VERIFIED record, not deleted. CAVEAT: this landed via concurrent work DURING this planning session; the package read private:true when first inspected — re-verify before executing enrichment-pipeline. (memory-core@0.3.0 hard-pins sox-ingest@0.1.0, so this also unblocks any future memory-core publish — BACKLOG SOX-PKG-001.)
sox-ingest-publishable.verification: node -e "process.exit(require('/Users/nix/dev/ai/sox-ecosystem/libs/data/ingest/ingest/package.json').private === false ? 0 : 1)" && ! grep -rq 'PRIVATE — never published' /Users/nix/dev/ai/sox-ecosystem/libs/data/ingest/ingest/src && echo 'OWNER SIGN-OFF OK (private:false + invariant removed, commit f4897aa)'
sox-ingest-publishable.how_to_provide: Already done in sox-ecosystem commit f4897aa: @adhd/sox-ingest package.json is private:false and the 'PRIVATE — never published … only the memory domain composer may call this' header invariant is removed. Re-verify with the verification command before enrichment-pipeline executes (the change was concurrent to this session).
